title: LLM briefing output
description: Structured output the model must return for a briefing (action=brief, cache miss). Sent to OpenAI as response_format.json_schema with strict=true, so the provider enforces it; OpenAiClient raises LlmSchemaMismatch on any deviation. Prompt::briefingSchema() loads this file.

sentences.description: Short list of cited sentences, most important first. May be empty.
